definitions.height: Top of head to sole, standing in A-pose.
definitions.bust: Horizontal tape at bust-point (nipple) level, arms excluded; tape bridges hollows (convex hull).
definitions.waist: Horizontal torso girth at the natural waist level: where the neutral body is narrowest, kept at the same fraction of the crotch-to-nipple distance (see waistLevel); arms excluded.
definitions.hips: Horizontal girth at the level of maximum buttock prominence: where the neutral body's buttocks protrude furthest back, kept at the same fraction of the crotch-to-nipple distance (see hipLevel); hands excluded.
definitions.shoulder: Back shoulder width: surface distance across the back from left to right shoulder point via the cervicale (C7), tape bridges hollows. Shoulder point = corner of the front silhouette where the shoulder line turns into the arm.
definitions.arm_length: Shoulder point to outer elbow point to outer wrist point (along the slightly bent A-pose arm), averaged over both arms.

surrogate.features: [1, k_0..k_15, k_i*k_j for (i, j) in pairs]; k = 16 key weights in 'keys' order

solver.method: Gauss-Newton with box limits, one-sided finite differences at 0, step halving

stage2.rule: solve with stage2 controls fixed at 0; if any |residual| > whenResidualAboveCm, solve again with all controls

range.rule: Solve with the surrogate; if any |predicted residual| > acceptResidualCm, the figure is out of range → show BodyAvatar.
